cases.name: continue-reaches-condition
cases.body:
var i=0
var n=0
do{i++
if(i<3){continue}
n++}while(i<4)
return n
cases.cs: int i=0,n=0; do{i++; if(i<3)continue; n++;}while(i<4); return n;

cases.name: break-exits-loop
cases.body:
var i=0
do{i++
if(i==2){break}}while(true)
return i
cases.cs: int i=0; do{i++; if(i==2)break;}while(true); return i;

cases.name: body-local-in-condition
cases.body:
var i=0
do{let step=2
i+=step}while(i<5)
return i
cases.cs: int i=0; do{int step=2; i+=step;}while(i<5); return i;

cases.name: nested-in-for
cases.body:
var total=0
for(var i=0;i<2;i++){var j=0
do{j++}while(j<3)
total+=j}
return total
cases.cs: int total=0; for(int i=0;i<2;i++){int j=0; do{j++;}while(j<3); total+=j;} return total;

cases.name: condition-compound
cases.body:
var i=0
do{i++}while(i<2 && i!=1)
return i
